identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open, Single-arm, Phase 1 Study to Evaluate the Safety/Preliminary Effectiveness and Determine the Maximal Tolerated Dose of B7-H3-targeting CAR-T Cell Therapy in Treating Recurrent Glioblastomas

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: a "3+3" design is used to determine Maximum Tolerated Dose (MTD) and the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2D)

primaryOutcomes.description: To evaluate the DLT incidence occurred within three months after B7-H3 CAR-T cells infusion
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: three months post CAR-T cells infusion

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety：Incidence and severity of adverse events
primaryOutcomes.description: To evaluate the possible adverse events occurred within three months after B7-H3 CAR-T cell infusion, including the incidence and severity of symptoms such as cytokine release syndrome and neurotoxicity
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: three months post CAR-T cells infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects who have survived for more than 12 months since the diagnosis of recurrent glioblastoma
The proportion of subjects reaching complete remission / partial remission in optimal remission

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Samples collected pre-injection, and 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11,13 days post the first injection; Samples collected pre-injection, and 2, 7, 13 days post re-injections

secondaryOutcomes.description: time to reach maximum plasma concentration (tmax)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Samples collected pre-injection, and 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11,13 days post the first injection; Samples collected pre-injection, and 2, 7, 13 days post re-injections

secondaryOutcomes.description: area under the plasma concentration-time curve from time zero to 28 days after dosing (AUC(0-28))
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Sample taken pre-injection, and 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11,13 days post the first injection; Sample taken pre-injection, and 2,7,13 days post re-injections
